info.name: ImageKit Account Management API URL endpoints API

items.docs:
**Note:** This API is currently in beta.  
Returns an array of all URL‑endpoints configured including the default URL-endpoint generated by ImageKit during account creation.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the URL-endpoint. This is generated by ImageKit when you create a new URL-endpoint. For the default URL-endpoint, this is always `default`.
